title: Our Team & Clinic — AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm
description: Meet the team and facilities at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic in Benidorm. 35+ years caring for skin, specialists in INDIBA Radiofrequency, Ultherapy HIFU and aesthetic medicine.

hero.label: About Us
hero.sub: Where you can treat yourself and give your skin the care it deserves

historia.label: Our Story
historia.h2: 35 years of experience and passion for skin
historia.p1: It all began five years ago, when a passionate Argentine aesthetician with over 35 years of experience in skincare started this dream. Today, we continue to honour her legacy, bringing dedication and excellence to every treatment.
historia.p2: We know that every person is unique and every skin has its own needs, which is why we offer a personalised approach to every client. Your wellbeing and confidence are our priority.

items.p: Promoting the wellbeing of our skin and body is of vital importance through aesthetics and cosmetology.
Beauty is a fundamental part of feeling wonderful — with ourselves and with the world around us.
Relaxation is essential to help us feel free and at peace. Rest is indispensable to our overall health.

equipo.label: The team
equipo.sub: Our team brings together wonderful qualities and strengths: professionalism, warmth, kindness, good judgement, and a genuine smile from the very first moment.

instalaciones.label: Our space
instalaciones.sub: Every corner is designed so you feel comfortable, safe, and in good hands from the very first moment.

cta.h2: Would you like to visit us?
cta.p: Come and visit our clinic in Benidorm or get in touch to answer any questions you may have.
